verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Claude has a terminal tool for coding (claude-docs-1), an API (claude-docs-2), and task scheduling (claude-docs-14). None of it documents a headless or non-interactive mode, CI integration, or pipeline usage. The API is a developer building block for constructing automation, not a headless run mode of the product, and community reports describe Claude Code as an interactive CLI. With no evidence of the capability itself, this is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
